title: Success Chime
blurb: An ascending major arpeggio, the most reliably optimistic shape in Western music and the reason every app in existence reaches for it. Task complete, payment accepted, answer correct — a small victory, formally recognised. It works because the pitch rises and then resolves, so your brain reads a finished journey rather than an interrupted one. Use it for channel-point wins, for quiz-night answers, or ironically after doing the absolute bare minimum. The optimistic sibling of the wrong-answer buzzer, and the two make an excellent double act.
origin: Original C-major arpeggio synthesis in the style of app success sounds.
